narr: Favorable instability (MLCAPE 1,500-2,000 J/kg) and moisture (PWATs 1.3-1.6) for thunderstorm development were in place across eastern Riverside on the 20th. Daytime heating combined with orographic forcing aided in developing isolated thunderstorms across Joshua Tree National Park during the afternoon hours. Given the lack of steering flow, thunderstorms in the park had very little movement, causing heavy rainfall to occur over the same area and led to isolated flash flooding. No damage or injuries were reported.
ev: Flooding was reported along Park Boulevard near Mount Minerva Hoyt, impacting travel on the road. No damage or injuries were reported.
